agb.title: General Terms and Conditions (GTC)
agb.s1_text: These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to all contracts for services in the field of IT security concluded between Bytes Security GmbH and its customers.
agb.s2_text: A contract is concluded when the customer accepts an offer from Bytes Security GmbH in writing or electronically, or receives a written order confirmation.
agb.s3_text: The exact scope of services results from the respective offer or service description. Changes or extensions require a written agreement.
agb.s4_text: All prices are net, plus statutory value-added tax. Payments are due within 14 days of invoicing without deduction, unless otherwise agreed.
agb.s5_text: The customer undertakes to provide all necessary information and to enable access to systems, insofar as this is required for the provision of the services.
agb.s6_text: Bytes Security GmbH is liable for damages caused by intent or gross negligence. In cases of slight negligence, it is liable only for breach of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations).
agb.s7_text: Personal data is processed in accordance with our privacy policy and the applicable data protection laws.
agb.s8_text: Both parties undertake to keep confidential all confidential information obtained in the course of the contractual relationship and not to disclose it to third parties.
agb.s9_text: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies. To the extent permitted by law, the place of jurisdiction for all disputes is the registered office of Bytes Security GmbH.
dsg.s2_text: This website is hosted by STRATO AG, Pascalstraße 10, 10587 Berlin. Personal data collected on this website is stored on STRATO's servers. A data processing agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR is in place with STRATO.
dsg.s3_text: As a general rule, we process our users' personal data only to the extent necessary to provide a functional website as well as our content and services. Processing generally takes place only with the user's consent or on the basis of legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(a) and (f) GDPR).
dsg.s4_text: The hosting provider automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser transmits to us automatically (browser type, operating system used, referrer URL, host name of the accessing computer, time of the server request, IP address). This data is not merged with other data sources.
dsg.s5_text: If you send us inquiries via the contact form, the information you provide in the form (name, email address, phone number, subject, message) is stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions. We do not pass on this data without your consent. Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where your inquiry is related to the performance of a contract or is necessary for taking pre-contractual steps. In all other cases, processing is based on our legitimate interest in the effective handling of inquiries (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
dsg.s6_a: For online appointment booking, we use the “Microsoft Bookings” service of Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052-6399, USA. When you use the booking function, the data you enter (e.g. IP addresses) is transmitted to and processed by Microsoft. A transfer of data to the USA cannot be ruled out. For further information, please see Microsoft's privacy statement at
dsg.s6_b: . Processing is based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you give by using the booking function.
dsg.s7_text: For security reasons, this site uses SSL/TLS encryption to protect the transmission of confidential content. You can recognize this by “https://” in your browser's address bar.
dsg.s8_text: You have the right at any time to receive information free of charge about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of the data processing, as well as the right to rectification, blocking or deletion of this data. For this and for further questions on data protection, you can contact us at any time at the address given in the legal notice. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
dsg.s9_text: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to reflect changes to our services.
